ITEM 1 | Pale brown, dense grains with slightly chewy, matte texture, mixed with dark specks and small dark red bits, forming a mound about 9 cm across and 2 cm high, sitting upper-center of plate, slightly moist but not flowing | 150
ITEM 2 | Pieces of pinkish-orange fish-like flesh, flaky and moist, some edges browned and glazed, cut into chunks about 3 to 4 cm, lower-left of plate, with dark green herb flecks and rice-like grains mixed in | 170
ITEM 3 | Diced raw-looking vegetable mix of pale green cucumber cubes about 1 cm, red bell pepper pieces, and dark green herb leaves, moist and glossy, arranged in a heap about 6 cm across, right side of plate | 80
ITEM 4 | Loose pale rice-like grains with small flecks of orange-pink flesh and green herbs, slightly sticky and crumbly, spread about 5 cm across, right of the diced vegetables and beside the fish | 60
ITEM 5 | Small dark green leaves, a few scattered on the fish and vegetables, glossy and thin, under 2 cm each | 5
